questions.q: Identify the error: The Arabian Nights / are indeed / an interesting book / No Error.
questions.s: Subject-Verb Agreement! 'The Arabian Nights' ek kitaab ka title hai (Singular Proper Noun). Iske saath verb 'is' aayegi, 'are' nahi.

questions.q: Identify the error: My politics / is very moderate / while his are radical / No Error.
questions.s: Contextual Number! Jab 'Politics' subject ki tarah use ho toh singular hota hai, lekin jab 'vichaardhara' (political views) ki tarah use ho, toh *Plural* hota hai. 'My politics are...' sahi hoga.

questions.q: Identify the error: He took / great pain / to complete / his project.
questions.s: Meaning Change! 'Pain' = Dard. 'Pains' = Prayas (Effort). 'He took great pains' (kadi mehnat ki) sahi phrase hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: The court awarded him / five lakh rupees / as a damage / for the loss.
questions.s: Legal Term! 'Damage' = Nuksaan. 'Damages' = Muavza (Compensation). Court muavza deta hai, isliye 'Damages' aayega.

questions.q: Identify the error: The infantry / was ordered / to march forward / immediately.
questions.s: Hidden Plural! 'Infantry' (paidal sena), 'Cavalry', 'Peasantry' dikhne mein singular lagte hain par *Plural* hote hain. 'Were ordered' aayega.

questions.q: Identify the error: The clergy / in this church / is opposed / to the new rule.
questions.s: Collective Noun! 'Clergy' (pudari log) group of priests hota hai aur ye plural treat kiya jata hai. 'Are opposed' sahi hoga.

questions.q: Identify the error: Please put / your sign / at the bottom / of the paper.
questions.s: Slang vs Formal! 'Sign' verb hai (hastakshar karna). Noun form 'Signature' hai. Formal English mein 'Put your signature' bolte hain.

questions.q: Identify the error: I live / in a boarding / near the / university.
questions.s: Incomplete Noun! 'Boarding' adjective/verb hai. Jagah ke liye 'Boarding House' ya 'Boarding School' pura bolna padta hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: He insists / on me going / there immediately / No Error.
questions.s: Gerund Rule! 'Going' gerund hai. Usse pehle possessive case aana chahiye. 'On *my* going' sahi hoga.

questions.q: Identify the error: The gallows / were / erected / in the square.
questions.s: Deceptive Noun! 'Gallows' (phaansi ka fanda) 's' pe khatam hota hai par ye *Singular* noun hai. 'The gallows *was* erected' sahi hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: These swines / are very / dirty / No Error.
questions.s: Same Form Rule! 'Swine' ka singular aur plural same rehta hai. 'Swines' koi word nahi hai. 'These swine' sahi hoga.

questions.q: Identify the error: The staff quarters / are / very comfortable / No Error.
questions.s: No Error. Rehne ki jagah ko 'Quarters' hi kehte hain (Plural form). 'Quarter' ka matlab 1/4th tukda hota hai. Context sahi hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: I have / misplaced my / spectacle / No Error.
questions.s: Noun Error! Nazare ke liye 'Spectacle', par chashme ke liye 'Spectacles' (plural) use hota hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: All the / members of the family / went to / the picnic.
questions.s: No Error. Hum aksar 'Family members' bolte hain jo acceptable hai, par grammatically 'Members of the family' zyada accurate maana jata hai. Yahan koi galti nahi hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: He bought / many equipments / for his / gym.
questions.s: Uncountable! 'Equipment' uncountable hai. 'Many pieces of equipment' ya sirf 'Equipment' sahi hai. 's' nahi lagega.

questions.q: Identify the error: This is / somebody's else / book / No Error.
questions.s: Possessive Rule! Jab Indefinite Pronoun (Somebody, Anyone) ke saath 'Else' lage, toh apostrophe 'Else' par lagta hai: 'Somebody else's'.

questions.q: Identify the error: We are / awaiting / for the tidings / No Error.
questions.s: Preposition Error + Noun usage. 'Await' ke saath 'for' nahi lagta (Superfluous). 'We are awaiting the tidings' sahi hai. (Note: Tidings = News, plural form mein hota hai).

questions.q: Identify the error: He treats / his servants / in a friendly / manners.
questions.s: Word Meaning! 'Manner' (singular) = Tareeka (Method). 'Manners' (plural) = Vyavahar/Tehzeeb (Behavior). Yahan 'friendly manner' (tareeka) ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye 's' hatao.

questions.q: Identify the error: She has / sold all / her effects / No Error.
questions.s: No Error. 'Effect' = Prabhav. 'Effects' = Samaan/Sampatti (Belongings). Yahan context 'samaan bechne' ka hai, toh 'Effects' bilkul sahi hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: A five-men / committee was / formed / yesterday.
questions.s: Hyphenated Noun! Jab Noun adjective ban jaye (hyphen ke baad), toh singular rehta hai. 'Five-man committee' sahi hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: The lady doctor / examined / the patient / carefully.
questions.s: Social Usage! Professional titles ke liye 'Lady' ka use avoid karte hain. 'Woman doctor' zyada appropriate aur formal maana jata hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: We have / a common friend / who lives / in Delhi.
questions.s: No Error. 'Mutual friend' galat hota hai (Dickens ke novel ke bawajood), kyunki 'Mutual' ka matlab 'reciprocal' (aapas ka) hota hai. Teesre insaan ke liye 'Common friend' sahi term hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: The judge / passed / an order / for his release.
questions.s: Contextual Plural! Court hamesha 'Orders' pass karta hai (official instruction). 'Passed orders' sahi phrase hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: He has / a large number of / offsprings / No Error.
questions.s: Superfluous 's'! 'Offspring' (santan) singular aur plural same rehta hai. 'Offsprings' galat hai.

questions.q: Identify the error: The surroundings / of the place / is / enchanting.
questions.s: Subject-Verb Agreement! 'Surroundings' (vatavaran) plural noun hai. Iske saath verb 'Are' aayegi.
